content.purpose: Explains how to add continual learning to AI coding agents through hooks, scoped memory, reflection, and persistence patterns.
content.whenToUse: Use it when you are setting up agent learning infrastructure and need guidance on capturing experience across sessions and projects.
content.outputs: Provides setup guidance, memory organization details, storage options, compaction behavior, and practical implementation tips.
